Truck carrying 304 quintals of paddy seized in Kawardha

A truck carrying 304 quintals of paddy from Bihar was seized at the Chilfi checkpost in Kawardha. The seizure involved 750 bags of paddy and was reportedly due to violations of the Mandi Act. Another report states the administration seized a truck loaded with 300 quintals of paddy in Kawardha as part of action against paddy smuggling.
